name: std-hero
description: std-hero — the headline block at the top of a page, or a call-to-action banner further down. Optional eyebrow badge, headline, supporting text, up to two link actions, an optional copyable command, and optional media below or beside the copy. `look: banner` turns it into a contained call-to-action card. Links follow `href` (in-app path, #anchor, or absolute URL); each click also emits CTA_PRIMARY / CTA_SECONDARY with the href. Pick for landing, product, pricing and campaign pages.

alignment.description: Center the copy, or align it to the start edge

command.description: A shell command shown in a copyable code box under the actions, e.g. an install one-liner; empty hides it

lede.description: One or two sentences under the headline; empty hides it

look.description: hero = full-width page opener with an h1; banner = contained call-to-action card with an h2

mediaSrc.label: Media image
